chapter_seo_title: The Four Blood Servants Assemble — Han Li Faces Wu Jiuzhi Again
chapter_meta_description: The Four Blood Servants unite, Wu Jiuzhi reappears to save Green Pattern, and a synchronized Demonic Transformation signals an all-or-nothing escalation.
og_title: Reunion and Devastation — Han Li vs. Wu Jiuzhi
og_description: Old acquaintances become enemies as the Four Blood Servants launch a synchronized Demonic Transformation.
twitter_title: The Four Blood Servants Strike Together
twitter_description: Han Li’s Giant Sword Art meets Wu Jiuzhi’s timely rescue—and a blood-red cocoon signals war.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-level sword-manipulation technique that compresses a cultivator’s mana into a single, massive construct for overwhelming force; Han Li’s first true sword art.
A forced mutation where a cultivator or half-demon surrenders human form for raw demonic power, signaled here by the blood-colored cocoon phase.
Tools designed as a set that consume mana equivalent to a single tool while enabling multiple simultaneous attacks; Han Li’s strategic preference.
A high-grade defensive tool used by the Blood Servant Green Pattern, capable of withstanding significant punishment when reinforced by the user’s full mana.
Gold rings with a cold, biting aura, used as ranged attack tools by Green Pattern; shattered by Senior Brother Wang.
The Thousand Bamboo School’s foundational mental cultivation technique for strengthening divine sense and enabling the Soul Divide technique; Han Li’s edge in controlling multiple tools.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was Han Li able to control over a dozen tools at once?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because they are a matched set; matched tools consume mana as if they were a single tool while allowing the user to activate multiple attacks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Green Pattern use more tools during the fight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was already using most of his divine sense to control his shield and rings; deploying more would leave him unable to perceive approaching danger.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the Demonic Transformation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It signals a last-resort, all-out escalation; the Blood Servants are abandoning conventional tactics for raw, monstrous power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li hesitate emotionally when he sees Wu Jiuzhi?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because Wu Jiuzhi was a clever, likable youth he met during his early travels; the reappearance forces Han Li to confront how time and survival have turned an old acquaintance into an enemy.
